summary: Make iOS landing screenshot pairing confirmation-driven, prevent Debug warning overlays only during explicit captures, and stop and verify simulator log streams during cleanup

compatibility.detail: No protocol or harness compatibility change; the Debug LogBox overlay is disabled only when EXPO_PUBLIC_FRACTAL_LANDING_CAPTURE=1, while Metro warnings remain available.

manual.detail: No upgrade steps; the screenshot script sets its capture-only flag and manages its disposable simulator and logger automatically.

recovery.detail: No data migration or recovery action.
